vocab.word: avoir les yeux plus gros que le ventre
vocab.ipa: /a.vwaʁ le.z‿jø ply ɡʁo kə lə vɑ̃tʁ/
vocab.mean: to have eyes bigger than your stomach
vocab.ex: Au restaurant, mon fils a toujours les yeux plus gros que le ventre.
vocab.exEn: At restaurants, my son's eyes are always bigger than his stomach.

vocab.mean: to ring the changes, to mix things up

vocab.mean: to get worked up, to overthink (informal)

vocab.mean: to still be hungry; to be left wanting more
